messages:
liam_sdr: Hello team, I'm Liam (SDR) starting today. Trying to get HubSpot + Dialpad access but HubSpot says 'no workspace' and Dialpad says 'contact admin'. Who do I ping?

rachel-ops: Welcome Liam! Ping me for playbook access. For HubSpot/Dialpad we use the provisioning form in the checklist. Did you submit it?

liam_sdr: I filled the checklist but maybe missed the account request form. Where is it?

rachel-ops: It's in the onboarding doc under "Tools -> Sales Accounts". Quick link: https://redwood.example.com/onboard/tools (internal). If you want I'll file the ticket for you.

liam_sdr: Please file if you don't mind. Need Gong access too for call review.

rachel-ops: On it. @it-portal-bot can you create a provisioning ticket for HubSpot, Dialpad, Gong for liam_sdr? Include role=SDR and repo access to /sales/playbooks.

it-portal-bot: Ticket created: IT-2401 184 026-03-23T16:05:02Z. Items: HubSpot (SDR), Dialpad (seat), Gong (view), Sales drive. Estimated SLA: 4 hours. Link: https://tickets.redwood.internal/IT-2401

santiago: hey @liam_sdr welcome! In the meantime you can shadow my calls: calendar invite "SDR shadow - santiago" is recurring. Also call script and one-pager in #sales-playbooks channel.

liam_sdr: Thanks @santiago. Quick Q 10 do we have an abbreviated cold-open script for voicemails?

santiago: Yep 10 Use this: `Hi, this is [Name] at Redwood Inference. We're working with teams building LLM features to reduce inference costs. Can I get 10 minutes next week to share a quick idea? Callback: [number].`

rachel-ops: IT-2401 update: HubSpot workspace created, invite sent to liam_sdr. Dialpad: seat pending licensing approval. Gong: SSO invite scheduled.

liam_sdr: Got the HubSpot invite, can log in and see contacts. Thank you!

sales-ops-bot: Pro tip: set your HubSpot email sync in settings -> integrations -> email to auto-cc redwood-sales@redwood.com for call logging.

it-portal-bot: IT-2401 status: Completed. Dialpad license assigned and routing profile 'SDR-Default' applied. Gong access granted (view only). Closed by rachel-ops-admin at 2026-03-23T16:25:30Z.

liam_sdr: All good now. Where can I find the playbook PDF and objection handling cheatsheet?

rachel-ops: Playbook: https://redwood.example.com/sales/playbooks/full-playbook.pdf. Objection cheatsheet pinned in #sales-playbooks. Added you to the drive folder. Welcome aboard! :tada:

liam_sdr: Appreciate it everyone, excited to start. I'll DM if any other setup stuff comes up.
